The Australian Competition and Consumer Commission (ACCC) has accepted a court enforceable undertaking from H&M Hennes & Mauritz Pty Ltd (H&M Australia) in relation to the supply of children’s nightwear and limited daywear that was allegedly non-compliant with the fire danger warning label requirements in the mandatory safety standard for children’s nightwear and limited daywear and therefore contravened section 106(1) of the ACL.
On 20 October 2026, the Australian Competition and Consumer Commission (ACCC) granted an exemption under section 56GD of the Competition and Consumer Act 2010 (Cth) to National Australia Bank Limited (NAB) from specified consumer data sharing obligations in respect of new instalment plan data for NAB Now Pay Later, for consumer data requests made from 9 November 2026 to 31 May 2027 inclusive.
On 20 October 2026, Lambda Networks Pty Ltd provided written notice to the ACCC electing to be bound by the class exemption under section 143A of the Telecommunications Act 1997.
